description: This file contains SwiftUI views and supporting shapes for rendering chat messages in a chat UI, including message bubbles, tool call cards, typing indicators, and message bodies with markdown rendering.

classes.name: ChatBubbleShape
classes.description: A shape for chat message bubbles, with optional left or right tail for speech bubbles.

classes.name: ChatMessageBubble
classes.description: Main view for displaying a chat message bubble, including message content and styling based on user or assistant role.

classes.name: ChatMessageBody
classes.description: View for rendering the content of a chat message, including markdown, attachments, and tool calls.

classes.name: AttachmentRow
classes.description: View for rendering a file attachment within a message.

classes.name: ToolCallCard
classes.description: View showing details of a tool call within a message.

classes.name: ToolResultCard
classes.description: View that displays the result of a tool, with toggle for full or truncated output.

classes.name: ChatTypingIndicatorBubble
classes.description: View showing animated dots indicating the assistant is typing.

classes.name: ChatStreamingAssistantBubble
classes.description: View displaying a streaming response message from the assistant.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolsBubble
classes.description: View indicating tools are currently running.

classes.name: ChatAssistantTextBody
classes.description: View for rendering assistant message text with markdown segments and optional thinking indicator.

methods.name: path(in: CGRect) -> Path
methods.description: Creates the drawing path for the chat bubble with optional tail.

methods.name: inset(by: CGFloat) -> ChatBubbleShape
methods.description: Returns a copy of the shape inset by a specified amount.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Compiles the main visual presentation of each chat message bubble, styling and conditional content.

methods.name: updateAnimationState
methods.description: Handles animation state changes for the typing indicator dots.
